models_evaluated: nine commercially available language models from three providers (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini families; specific versions not stated in text)

links.outcome: Effect of prompt variants and temperature on SIRI-2 benchmark scores
links.effect: Prompt design alone shifted individual model scores by as much as the difference between trained and untrained human groups; each item was run 60 times per model across prompt variants, temperatures and repetitions.
links.quote: Prompt design alone shifted individual model scores by as much as the difference between trained and untrained human groups.

links.outcome: Whether a single benchmark score reflects clinical competence given configuration and measurement floor
links.effect: Total scores ranged from 19.5 to 84.0 (expert baseline 32.5); best model approached the instrument's measurement floor; a single score can support markedly different claims depending on configuration.
links.quote: A single benchmark score can support markedly different claims depending on the assumed standard of clinical behavior, the instrument’s remaining measurement range, and the configuration that produced the result.

links.outcome: Model ratings of clinically inappropriate suicide-intervention responses that sounded supportive
links.effect: All nine models consistently overrated clinically inappropriate responses that sounded supportive, relative to expert consensus.
links.quote: All nine models consistently overrated clinically inappropriate responses that sounded supportive.

unlisted_practices: Involving clinicians in designing, validating, and interpreting language model benchmarks
Reporting benchmark configuration (prompt, temperature) and instrument measurement floor/ceiling alongside scores

screen.practice: prompt design and temperature configuration for LLM responses to suicide-intervention items
screen.reason: Empirical benchmarking study evaluating clinical safety of nine LLMs using a suicide intervention instrument across different prompt variants and temperature settings.
